text:
anya: heads-up — planning kernel v2.4.1 (q8 build) rollout during the 17:30-19:30 UTC change window. small canary then ramp.

mike: sgtm. any deviations from the usual sticky-pin behavior?

anya: yes — deploybot now supports a sticky pin TTL param. default was 30m, proposing 2h for this rollout due to known slow warmups for some models.

raj: +1 on longer TTL if we can gate canary more tightly. what's the canary slice?

anya: canary = 2% of traffic, then 20% after 15m, then 100% if no regressions. canary group limited to regional traffic (us-west-2) and non-critical customers.

deploybot: preflight checks starting...
```
deploybot: checks=12/12 PASS
deploybot: binaries signed: kernel-v2.4.1-q8.sha256 OK
deploybot: compat-tag: runtime/kernel>=2.4 && model/quantized=true
```

sre-oncall: I'll watch eviction and OOM alerts. setting short-term alert with 5m cadence.

julie: FYI perf SIG saw ~6% tail-latency bump in internal perf run for long-context LLMs, likely due to kernel scheduling change. should we add a rollback threshold?

anya: yes — rollback criteria: (1) 5m sustained p99 increased by >20% vs baseline OR (2) >1.5% error-rate increase in inference responses OR (3) new OOMs >0.02% of requests in the canary slice.

mike: can deploybot apply pin only to canary nodes and not global?

deploybot: yes. command: `/deploy kernel v2.4.1 --quant q8 --canary 2% --pin sticky --pin-ttl 2h --regions us-west-2`

kim: add short release-note line: "kernel v2.4.1: q8 kernel scheduling tweaks; sticky pin TTL introduced to reduce churn during warmup; watch p99 for long-context models."

raj: also note rollback matrix: model-tag compatibility + fallback to kernel-v2.3.9 if pinned. ops playbook updated.

buildbot: build artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-artifacts/kernel/v2.4.1/q8/ (checksum attached).

anya: decision: proceed with canary at 17:30 UTC, pin TTL=2h. If we hit rollback criteria, immediate unpin and roll to v2.3.9 with hotfix routing.

mike: :thumbsup: I'll stay on for the 17:30-18:30 monitoring window.

sre-oncall: alerting set; dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/kk-kernel-rollouts

julie: I'll draft the short notify to customer success in case any customers see minor perf blips.

anya: thanks all. will post final deploy command and release-note snippet 15m before window. :eyes:
